design.reward_other_groups: dropped by the filter (reward 0, never trained on)
design.stopping_rule: only mixed groups (1<=k<=7) advance the stopping counter; efficiency groups are cached in stream order and injected at the stopping batch as mixed[:32-m] + cache[:m], m = min(2, |cache|)

cell_E1_D120.reward: R_i = A_i (1 + 0.05 E_i), all retained groups

cell_E1_E120.filter: e1e_quota_metric (mixed EM + injected all-correct efficiency groups)
cell_E1_E120.reward: mixed: A_i; gated efficiency group: 1 + 0.05 E_i
